//: Response headers for the built web apps. Kept in sync by hand with infra/Caddyfile (production); vite preview uses this file so a production build can be tested with the same policy. Media may come from a CDN host, hence https: for images, media and fetches; blob: is hls.js (MSE).
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; media-src 'self' blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https:; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
